_comment: One definition per repeated quantity (F3). The canonical key is the definition the paper uses without qualification. A variant is a different quantity that happens to share a name; prose may quote it only on a line that also matches its qualifier. Checked by tools/check_numbers.py --definitions. Definitions are explained in docs/DEFINITIONS.md.
